findings.explanation: Government/collocation nit: 'пильнувати' (to guard, keep watch over something valuable — пильнувати дитину/майно) does not idiomatically take 'пастки' as its object, since one avoids traps rather than guards them. A native editor would use 'стерегтися + genitive' or 'уникати + genitive'. Borderline-tolerable in the colloquial register but flagged as the single residual naturalness defect.
